ui_bugs.issue: Notification read/unread styling is based on `item.read_by.length` instead of current user id, so one staff member reading can visually mark item as read for others.

action_items: Fix notification item CSS state in frontend to compute read/unread by current staff id (not any read_by entry).

UI e2e verified admin/staff notification visibility and admin-only audit panel. One UI logic bug remains in notification read styling per-user handling.
rca of the issue: RCA for UI read-style bug: in frontend/src/App.js NotificationCenter, className uses `item.read_by?.length` which reflects global read state, not user-specific read state. Backend unread_count correctly computes with current staff id, so visual state can diverge from actual per-user unread logic. Mitigation: pass current staff id to NotificationCenter and compute `isRead = item.read_by?.includes(currentStaffId)` for class assignment.
